correctness.rationale: PASS. Rebuilt actual 75 published tetrahedra and all faces of the labeled 15-vertex S³/Q triangulation. Independent GF(2) elimination gave ranks ∂1=14, ∂2=74 in spaces C1=90, hence H1 dimension 2. Among all 455 triples, exactly 120 are missing triangles and all have nonzero mod-2 boundary classes distributed 40,40,40. No shorter simple graph cycle exists, so these exhaust 1-systolic carriers at edge length 3. Published permutation generators generate 180 distinct facet-preserving automorphisms, with missing-triangle orbits 90 and 30 and balances (30,30,30) and (10,10,10). This is an exhaustive finite proof for the specified triangulation, independently recomputed rather than inferred from logs.
